source.title: NIST Special Publication 800-215: Guide to a Secure Enterprise Network Landscape
source.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
source.applicability: Covers modern network segmentation approaches including zero trust architectures, microsegmentation, and security frameworks (ZTNA/SASE). Addresses network inventory, traffic controls, and security review processes for distributed enterprise environments as defined in the scope.
